practiceHub.title: Practice
practiceHub.subtitle: Choose a task type to start a practice session with AI-generated stimuli and instant feedback.
practiceHub.mockTitle: All task types in PTE order
practiceHub.mockDesc: Strict timing enforced — no early stops on speaking tasks.
practiceHub.desc.read-aloud: Read an AI-generated passage aloud as clearly and naturally as possible.
practiceHub.desc.repeat-sentence: Listen to a sentence once, then repeat it verbatim.
practiceHub.desc.answer-short-question: Hear a factual question and give a brief spoken answer (1–3 words).
practiceHub.desc.personal-intro: Introduce yourself — background, studies, and goals. Unscored in PTE.
practiceHub.desc.describe-image: Study a chart, map, or diagram for 25s, then describe it aloud in detail.
practiceHub.desc.re-tell-lecture: Listen to a short AI-generated lecture, then re-tell it in your own words.
practiceHub.desc.summarize-written-text: Read a passage, then write a one-sentence summary (5–75 words).
practiceHub.desc.write-essay: Write a 200–300 word essay in response to a given question.
practiceHub.desc.write-from-dictation: Listen to a sentence, then type exactly what you heard.
practiceHub.desc.summarize-spoken-text: Listen to an academic passage, then write a 50–70 word summary.
practiceHub.desc.fill-in-the-blanks-list: Listen to a passage read aloud, then select the correct word for each blank.
practiceHub.desc.highlight-correct-summa: Listen to a passage, then choose the summary that best matches what you heard.
practiceHub.desc.fill-in-the-blanks: Read an academic passage and select the correct word from a dropdown for each blank.
practiceHub.desc.re-order-paragraphs: Drag shuffled paragraph tiles into the correct logical order.
practiceHub.desc.multiple-choice: Read a passage and select the one correct answer from five options.
practiceHub.theme.desc: Type a topic and every task card will generate themed stimuli.
practiceHub.theme.activeHint: Starting any task below will generate themed stimuli.
